high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the account "narendramodi." The post features a photograph of an aircraft carrier named "Vikrant," which is prominently displayed in the center of the image. The aircraft carrier is shown on the water under a partly cloudy sky, with the ocean stretching out to the horizon. The post includes the following text: "The Indigenous Aircraft Carrier 'Vikrant', designed by Indian Navy's Design Team and built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd., undertook its maiden sea sortie today. A wonderful example of Make In India.
